When positioned on a sea province, it can block connections (visible as broken red lines across the water) between land provinces, to prevent enemy land units from moving between them.

nodes.text: The magnitude of this effect is determined by the firepower of the ships involved: each point of heavy gun damage contributes
nodes.norm: The magnitude of this effect is determined by the firepower of the ships involved: each point of heavy gun damage contributes
nodes.unit: The magnitude of this effect is determined by the firepower of the ships involved: each point of heavy gun damage contributes -0.05%[5] to enemy attack and defense, while each point of light gun damage contributes -0.025%[6]. Total reduction from shore bombardment is capped at -33%[7]. Naval shore bombardment can also critically hit, causing severe damage to forts and coastal forts during combat.
